Package com.neueda.leap.order.model

Class Order

java.lang.Object
com.neueda.leap.order.model.Order
@Entity public class Order extends Object
Order entity representing a market order for trading securities. BR-04, BR-06, BR-07: Order submission with 2-phase commitment (SUBMITTED → ACCEPTED → FILLED/REJECTED). BR-16: Idempotency via client_reference prevents duplicate fills on retry.
